live.title: Coffee bag photos become structured data automatically
live.detail: Take a photo of a bag and the backend reads off the roaster, origin, farm, process, price, weight and rating for you.

live.title: Extraction picks are applied by default
live.detail: The engine's picks now land directly on the coffee instead of sitting in a review queue; review only shows genuine disagreements between voters.

live.title: Farm names are learned automatically
live.detail: A confident new farm name from a caption now creates its own vocabulary entry instead of being dropped; farm coverage jumped from 0/21 to 13/21 coffees on the first run.

live.title: Roaster countries filled in
live.detail: 80 of the 89 known roasters now have a home country on file, so origin filters and insights work for roaster country too.

live.title: Smaller cached photos
live.detail: On-device photo thumbnails shrank about 57% to stay comfortably under the app's 50 MB size budget.

live.title: Any coffee field can be corrected
live.detail: Roaster, farm, origin, process, price, weight, rating and roast date can all be fixed from the backend now; an in-app edit sheet with dropdowns is next.

data.title: Reject nonsense extracted numbers
data.detail: An altitude of '1-5 m' or a similarly implausible weight/rating should be dropped instead of shown, even though the engine applies picks by default now.

data.title: Trust an explicit caption over the vocab guess for roaster country
data.detail: Fix the 'Uncommon' roaster mixup (Amsterdam vs. a same-named UK roaster) and prefer what a caption actually says over a derived guess going forward.

ios.title: Hide the review affordance when there's nothing to actually review
ios.detail: A coffee's Review button shouldn't open an empty sheet when its only open items aren't client-reviewable.

ios.title: Wire up the field-edit API on the client
ios.detail: Let the app call the backend's edit endpoint so a correction saves for real, not just locally.

ios.title: Edit sheet with consistency dropdowns
ios.detail: A form to fix a coffee's roaster, origin, farm, process and other fields, with vocab pickers instead of free text.

ios.title: What's New API surface on the client
ios.detail: Fetch this screen's own data from the backend so it always reflects the real current state of the project.

ios.title: What's New screen
ios.detail: A Live/Plan view reachable from Settings so you can see what's shipped and what's queued, from inside the app.

needsApproval.title: Publish the accumulated iOS batch to TestFlight
needsApproval.detail: The review queue UI, insights, roaster/country pages and several fixes are done and compile-green on main, waiting on the scheduled publish run — not pushed manually per your instruction.

needsApproval.title: Launch the full photo backfill (~$62)
needsApproval.detail: Extracting all remaining photos needs your go-ahead per the spend gate; the free rules-only pass and the 5-photo sample are already validated.

needsApproval.title: Anything that would exceed the 50 MB app+data cap
needsApproval.detail: A bigger image cache, larger bundled assets, or a fatter snapshot all need your sign-off before shipping.
